2 Level 12 monsters
[b]Once[/b] [b]per turn[/b], if an Xyz Monster battled this turn, [b]you can[/b] [b]also[/b] Xyz Summon "Divine Arsenal AA-ZEUS - Sky Thunder" by using 1 Xyz Monster you control as material (transfer its materials to this card). ([b]Quick Effect[/b]): [b]You can[/b] detach 2 materials from this card; send all other cards from the field to the GY. [b]Once[/b] [b]per turn[/b], if another card(s) you control is destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect: [b]You can[/b] attach 1 card from your hand, Deck, or Extra Deck to this card.
